zh.title: 岳云鹏·孙越｜伦敦相声专场
zh.summary: 岳云鹏、孙越伦敦相声专场：围绕语言型演出组织本地制作配合。
zh.preview: 相声专场的核心是演员与观众之间的交流。本地制作需要围绕表演展开，连接舞台技术、人员、节目、妆造与记录。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与本地制作，将舞台及技术对接与人员、节目衔接联系起来，并配合妆造和现场记录。
zh.context: 岳云鹏与孙越是相声表演搭档。本案为两人在伦敦的演出提供本地制作配合，执行工作的重点是服务节目与演员的现场呈现。

narrativeSections.heading: 语言型演出的制作接口
narrativeSections.text: 演员、节目与舞台技术是这项工作的共同参照。我们的参与范围连接了这些接口，使人员与节目衔接的工作能够围绕演出本身展开。

narrativeSections.heading: 表演支持与现场记录
narrativeSections.text: 妆造配合与现场记录同属本案范围。交付既包括演出背后的本地制作支持，也包括双人表演与舞台内容的记录，体现巡演落地中的协作能力。

deliverables: 本地制作、舞台与技术对接
人员及节目衔接、妆造配合
outcomes: 交付包括伦敦演出的本地制作支持、妆造配合及双人表演与舞台记录。

en.title: Yue Yunpeng & Sun Yue | London Crosstalk
en.summary: Local production support for Yue Yunpeng and Sun Yue’s London crosstalk performance.
en.preview: The relationship between performers and audience is central to crosstalk. Local production supports that performance by connecting stage and technical liaison with people, programme, styling and documentation.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to local production, connecting stage and technical liaison with people and programme transitions, alongside styling and documentation.
en.context: Yue Yunpeng and Sun Yue perform crosstalk as a duo. This assignment supported their London performance, with local production work centred on the programme and its presentation on stage.

narrativeSections.heading: The interfaces behind the performance
narrativeSections.text: The performers, programme and stage requirements provided the shared reference for the work. Our involvement connected these interfaces, organising people and programme liaison around the performance itself.

narrativeSections.heading: Support and documentation
narrativeSections.text: Styling support and event documentation were also within scope. The delivery combined local production support with a record of the duo and the stage, demonstrating collaboration within a touring performance.

deliverables: Local production, stage and technical liaison
People, programme transitions and styling support
outcomes: The delivery comprised local production support, styling support and documentation of the duo and stage at the London performance.
